_doc: Which supplier parts each head-carrier screw post is made of (Idle T-5bqc3m). Post positions are never typed: robot/body/neck-head/head_holes.py measures the bore of the named spacer / shim / terminal nut on its mesh (cached in head_carrier_measured.json, so a manifest from which the spacers are already dropped still gives the same sites). group: screw family of the post; spacers / terminals / screws: manifest part names in post order; legacy_screws: manifest parts the generated screws replace; head: standard and thread of the screw (dk / k / lengths from robot/body/checks/data/hardware.json screw_standards; compute: ISO 10642 M2.5 dk / k written here, assumption). compute: pressed 304 sleeve around the post, screw into the nut. camera (owner 2026-11-22: only catalogue hardware, printable and hand-assemblable): the 8 supplier F-F standoffs are replaced by a printed column (column.ro, column.height 4.97 = the standoff's 5 mm less 0.03 mm so the board face never overlaps the column in the fit check; the screw clamp closes it) on the carrier plate with a clearance bore (column.bore_dia); a catalogue M2 brass heat-set insert (sleeve: OD 2 x ro, length) is pushed from the plate's rear face (before ROCK4D goes on) up to the bore's ledge and sits on the bore's ledge; the ISO 4762 M2 screw is driven from the camera front through board and column into the insert (sleeve.engagement_target_mm = 2.5 mm of thread engaged = 0.5 mm slack to the 1 d reference and 0.5 mm of the 3 mm insert left before the point; the ledge is placed per board from its head seat so both slacks are 0.5 mm, 0.3 mm at the +-0.2 mm hand-set insert depth; the screw length is the standard length whose insert rear end lies nearest behind the plate's rear face, nothing protrudes). mic (owner 2026-11-22: one screw, a printed retention instead of the upper screw): one M2 x 4 mm heat-set insert in a printed boss of the head skin's inner side (boss.ro, skin_part), its front end sleeve.recess_mm below the boss face the board rests on (hand-set depth +-0.2), pocket melt_pocket_mm deeper than the insert; the ISO 7045 M2 x 5 pan-head screw (dk 4.0, k 1.6; hardware.json) is driven from the board side (before ROCK4D goes on) through the PCB into the insert; two printed stops (stops) at the board's far upper-left corner keep it from turning about that screw. Insert sizes: catalogue-class M2 x 3.0 mm (camera) / x 4.0 mm (mic), OD 3.2-3.6 mm knurled (Ruthex / CNC Kitchen / Voron class); the modelled OD 3.5 is the hole size (no overlap check against the melted-in plastic). threads: ISO 724 M2 major / minor diameter of the insert's modelled bore (same values as torso_screws.THREADS). ASSUMPTIONS: no supplier data for the insert in the repo; thread modelled at the minor diameter; 1 d engagement for a steel screw in a brass thread.

stops._doc: printed in-plane stops at the board's upper-left corner (the corner farthest from the one screw): one rib over the top edge, one beside the left edge, each gap_mm clear of the board and t_mm thick; they reach overlap_mm into the board's thickness from its back face, the board slides in between them from the front, then the screw

threads._doc: ISO 724 M2: major 2.0, minor 1.567 (the threaded sleeve's modelled bore); same as torso_screws.THREADS (T-bv7bwe). Assumption: no supplier data for M2 threaded press-in sleeves in the repo.
